newsitem.title: GERMANY: German chemical sector to resume pay talks soon.
newsitem.headline: German chemical sector to resume pay talks soon.

text.p: German chemical industry employers are ready to resume negotiations with chemicals union IG Chemie over paying full sick pay benefits, the union said on Thursday.
The third round of talks affecting 590,000 workers in the industry has been brought forward to December 17 and 18, the union said.
It added it was ready to make concessions if employers were prepared to refrain from implementing a controversial law allowing them to cut pay by 20 percent during sickness.
Employers in the engineering and banking sectors, faced with fierce worker opposition to the planned cuts, have backed down from pushing through the smaller payments.
